Estimated jointly with the forecast-error equation; the return equation has no free intercept.
Market-adjusted buy-and-hold return is the compounded stock return minus the compounded value-weighted market return over the documented 60-month period-key window.
The source does not state the residual covariance or weighting matrix; direct Gaussian mlexp uses independent errors with separate constant variances to identify the recursive system.
Monthly return periods use month offsets +4 through +63, the 60 full monthly observations after the three-month post-offer delay.

limitations: The paper does not report the nonlinear equation-error covariance or weighting matrix. In the recursive full-covariance IFGNLS system, the return coefficient and star parameters are not separately identified; the naive null has only one testable reduced-form mean restriction although the routine reports two degrees of freedom. The final direct Gaussian likelihood assumes independent equation errors with separate constant variances so both source restrictions are identified; read its inference as best effort.
Historical source coverage and identifier linkage are vintage-dependent. Event links use dated Compustat/CRSP history; source sample counts are comparisons only.

The local SDC BFO underwriting field is missing for all 7,114 U.S. Public Common Shares candidates. The public-market/common-share classification is used as the best-effort universe, compared with 7,636 source offers; available fields do not establish the cause of the gap or a rights-offering screen.
Table 3 uses forecast-growth ranges to classify portfolios; the paper does not state an exclusion rule for Table 7. All nonmissing detail forecasts in the offer window contribute to the offer mean.
The six-year realized-growth start date conflicts between physical pp. 14 and 26; the Table 7 note is used. The paper also omits the exact log base and slope-to-annualized-growth conversion.
